note: Merged from the per-country TSVs in data/raw/museums/, which are the source of truth -- see that directory's README.md for each country's provenance and coverage caveats. Coverage is uneven by country and no country should be assumed exhaustive. A null category or kind means the source did not record one; it was not inferred. lat/lng are null throughout -- geocoding is a future step. Rows are not deduplicated by name: some names legitimately collide between distinct museums.
